name: company-data-clone
description: A clone of FinanciallyFree's order-tracking tool with company financial data sourced from Screener.in

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup:prod: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server exec playwright install chromium && npm run build
scripts.deploy: git pull && npm run setup:prod && pm2 restart trendingdata
